core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nashira is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Publisher, spreader”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nashira corresponds to the Arabic form نَاشِرَة (Arabic root ن ش ر (n-sh-r); نَاشِرَة (Nāshira)). Its core sense is nashira; a female given name. Nashira is Arabic نَاشِرَة (Nāshira) 'publisher, spreader' (feminine), from the root ن ش ر (n-sh-r). The source gloss 'Night Shining Star' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: ناشره

arabic.long_meaning: Nashira (نَاشِرَة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي نَاشِرَة (اسْم عَلَم مُؤَنَّث). يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
